Updated [usePreparation.js](/workspace/src/usePreparation.js:36) so the download dialog schedules another check while preparation is pending and records the file as complete only when a check reports ready. Closing or reopening the dialog cancels a scheduled retry and prevents an older result from updating the new visit.

Syntax validation and a controlled hook check passed for pending-to-ready, stale results, same-token reopening, and cleanup. React dependencies are absent from this workspace, so I could not run a rendered integration check.
